annotations.title: Stop using a phone number from Cosend

description: Stops a phone number from Cosend, named by id (cnm_…), that is verifying or ready, and returns it stopping, with release_at, its last day: an hour before the billing period ends. On that day any WhatsApp connection on it is disconnected and the number is given back for good; nothing is refunded, and nothing more is billed for it. It acts only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview of the number and a token for a person to approve; the number’s status, last day and WhatsApp connection are read again when the token comes back. Only a person’s approval stops it. Owners and admins; a workspace with an unpaid invoice may stop one too.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.
